market_summary: Mon Nov 9: S&P 500 +2.35% (best day since April), Nasdaq +2.74%, SOXX +7.5% with AMD +13% and Broadcom +9%, but Nvidia -4.3% after its board opened a probe into reports Jensen Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort. 10-yr rose 2bp to 4.88% and 2-yr 5bp to 4.56%; futures price about 78% odds of a December hike, with October CPI tonight (8:30am ET, consensus +0.3%). Brent fell 5.9% to $92.57 and power names rebounded: Constellation +10.5%, NRG +10.3%, Caterpillar +7.2% on Anthropic buying about $3.4B of its gas generators; no data-centre power law has passed. China October PPI rose 5.7% y/y, the fastest since June 2022 on energy, while CPI slowed to 0.7% and core to 0.8%; Beijing pledged steps to steady the stock market. CoreWeave reports tonight after a 15% drop last week; Cisco and AMAT report Nov 12, Nvidia Nov 17.

AMZN.reason: Up 2.9% Monday; JPMorgan kept it as a top internet pick, citing AWS growth of 39% in Q3.

AXOS.reason: Up 1.4% Monday with the market. No company news. Forward P/E about 9.

BABA.reason: Down 3.7% Monday with no stated cause. September-quarter results due Nov 19.

ENPH.reason: Up 2.2% Monday in the broad rally. No company news; still no sign of a turn.

FIGR.reason: Up 7.9% Monday in the rebound. No company news.

GOOGL.reason: Up 1.2% Monday, lagging the Nasdaq's 2.7%. JPMorgan dropped it from its focus list; Cloud grew 103% in Q3.

LDI.reason: Q3 missed: net loss $29M vs $7M in Q2, volume down 12%, lower Q4 volume guide. Fell 17% Monday.

META.reason: Up 5.1% Monday after JPMorgan added it to its focus list; Q3 ad revenue grew 26%.

MRVL.reason: Up 9.5% Monday with chips, no company news. Lumentum deal overhang and target cuts remain.

MU.reason: Up 6.3% Monday as the chip index rose 6.9%. Forward P/E about 4.

NVDA.reason: Down 4.3% Monday while chips rose 6.9%; board probe into CEO conduct. Q3 results next week are the test.

TSM.reason: Up 3.5% Monday. October revenue up 59.7% year on year and 14.7% on September.

STRIPE.reason: No new round or tender reported.

OPENAI.reason: Closed $11B of a round at $1.25T, the same valuation already reported; mark unchanged.

headlines: Nvidia -4.3% Monday as its board probes the CEO, while the chip index rose 6.9%.
loanDepot Q3 missed: loss widened to $29M, volume -12%; shares -17%. Take moved to trim.
S&P 500 +2.35%, best day since April; MU +6.3%, MRVL +9.5%, META +5.1%.
TSMC October revenue +59.7% year on year.
Anthropic to set its IPO range this week, with trading expected next week.
Next: US CPI tonight 8:30am ET (Wed 12:30am AEDT); CoreWeave after close; Nvidia Nov 17.
